def create_gsl_matrix_complex(np_array):
    rows, cols = np_array.shape
    gsl_matrix = gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_create(rows, cols)
    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):
            real_part = np_array[i, j].real
            imag_part = np_array[i, j].imag

    data_ptr = data.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
